title: Multiplicative recurrence of Piatetski--Shapiro and nil-Bohr sets
summary: Adapting the circle method developed by Frantzikinakis--Klurman--Moreira, we establish a sufficient criterion for a set of natural numbers to be multiplicatively recurrent. We apply this criterion to Piatetski--Shapiro sets with small exponents and to regular irrational nil-Bohr sets. We also study the value distribution of unimodular completely multiplicative functions along these sets.
